🎶 Something new is coming to Kurious Tots!

Over the past few months, Kurious Tots has been in conversation with a number of cafés and creative spaces across the city to find the right “performance partner” for our children.

We’re very happy to share that we’ve found that partner in Urban Solace Cafe, Ulsoor, Bangalore! 
myurbansolace 

Together, we’re starting The Little Stage — a small monthly concert where children aged 4–15 can step up to a real microphone and perform a song solo, duet or even share an original composition.

A few things to know:
🎤 Children can perform solo, duet or trio. 
🎵 They can perform something they already know/ something they're currently learning
✍️ Original songs/compositions are welcome
⏱️ Each child can perform a maximum of 2 pieces per concert
🌟 Slots will be limited so that every child gets a chance

📍 Venue: Urban Solace Cafe, Opposite Ulsoor lake
📅 When: 1st Sunday of every month
⏰ Time: 11.30am
🥳 Audience- ENTRY FREE (More the merrier)

Registrations open on 1st Oct

The wild things are calling again!🌿
Our first walk with Natasha Rego took us out into the open, with songs, new friends, a little adventure and lots of muddy-shoe energy. Now, we're doing it again. 

The 2nd edition of 'There the Wild Things Sing' takes us to a new spot around Nandi Hills for another morning of walking, exploring and learning.

The Community Songbook — Chapter 2 🎶

We’re back with another edition of The Community Songbook — a morning of music, familiar favourites, unexpected throwbacks, and plenty of singing together.
You won’t just be listening. You’ll have a part to play. 😉
And there’s more — the day is all for a good cause, with food, games and community.
